description.en: OpenCode's free-tier models on opencode.ai/inference, with live model discovery and multi-identity account isolation.
description.zh: opencode.ai/inference 免费档模型，支持在线动态发现模型列表与多账号独立身份隔离。

description.en: Each created account receives a distinct, isolated project and session identity. You may enter any custom label (e.g. account nickname) or leave it as public.
description.zh: 每次创建的账号都会自动分配全新的独立设备与项目会话身份，实现完全隔离。可填入任意自定义身份别名或填 public。

label.zh: 身份别名 / 凭据（如 public、dev-1）
